feeds.title: Habe-Ich-Selbstgemacht
feeds.description: We are Alex and Tina, the founders and creative minds. The blog features hundreds of delicious and easy-to-follow recipes, ranging from bread to sweets to savory dishes to drinks. The recipes are sometimes classic, occasionally extraordinary, often a bit healthier, but always tested and delicious.

feeds.title: Salamico
feeds.description: Dominik von Salamico is a pizza-baking enthusiast and loves to talk about the various aspects and factors involved in baking pizza. Explore a wonderful assortment of Pizza recipes, all varying in flavor but consistent in quality, via the latest articles on his blog.

feeds.title: Gernekochen
feeds.description: Auf dem Food-Blog Gerne Kochen finden Sie köstliche und schmackhafte Rezepte für jedermann. Theres & Benni, die diesen Blog bereits 2014 ins Leben gerufen haben, erzählen viel über ihre leckeren Rezepte und andere Berichte und Geschichten aus der Küche.

feeds.title: Bake to the roots
feeds.description: Bake to the roots is a food & baking blog where you can find recipes for cupcakes, cakes, tarts, cookies, bread and much much more! Hi, my name is Marc. I'm a graphic designer. I love my job, but in between, I love to bake and try new things in the kitchen.

feeds.title: My Best German Recipes
feeds.description: Find here the best original and authentic German Recipes. Learn how to make German dishes like we do in Germany. More than 700 recipes. MyBestGermanRecipes.com was created by Gabriele Utz, born and educated in Germany. While living in Germany and Switzerland, Gabriele always liked to bake and cook. In 2010 Gabriele started the website MyBestGermanRecipes.com that has now more than 600 original German recipes.

feeds.title: Feed Me Up Before You Go-Go
feeds.description: Kulinarisches aus Berlin, New York und dem Rest der Welt. Der Food- und Reiseblog aus Berlin | Rezepte und kulinarische Reiseberichte

feeds.title: Dirndl Kitchen
feeds.description: Sophie's German kitchen. To make myself feel more at home in this big, new country, I prepare, devour and share German food in my kitchen at home.

feeds.title: Lets have breakfast
feeds.description: I'm Andrea and this is my food blog! Here I share my self-designed recipes and my passion for fresh and simple ingredients. Have fun trying!

feeds.title: Elbcuisine Blog
feeds.description: I'm always on the lookout for new culinary delights, or new tips and tricks on how to easily cook for the family in everyday life, for example how to bake bread faster, naturally without chemical additives. I'm Bianca - nice that you ended up with me! Be inspired by my delicious and simple ideas!

feeds.title: Dinner um Acht
feeds.description: Bekanntester deutscher Reiseblog seit 2010 mit Fokus auf Kulinarik. Sieger des Burda Awards und bester kulinarischer Travel Blog 2016. Städtereisen, Roadtrips, besondere Restaurants in aller Welt.Mit vielen Rezepten zur typischen Länderküche. Saisonale Rezepte mit Zutaten aus der Region.

feeds.title: evchenkocht
feeds.description: On my enjoyment and food blog evchenkocht.de you will find many recipes to cook at home, culinary travel reports and much more. My name is Eva and I've been blogging here since summer 2015. I write about delicious recipes from my cooking pot, culinary highlights and regional tips on food and wine.

feeds.title: Diary of a Mad Hausfrau
feeds.description: I'm an Emmy-nominated television producer and a scuba diving/travel junkie. I have no formal culinary training but the kitchen is my happy place, baking is my therapy and I enjoy the exchange of ideas and creativity food blogging provides. I have created recipes for the Duncan Hines website, was the German Food Expert for About.com and am a member of The Daily Meal's Culinary Content Network.

feeds.title: My Dinner
feeds.description: My Dinner is a German Food Blog dedicated to share traditional German Recipes as well as experimenting with Lebanese Cuisine. Written from London, UK.

feeds.title: Germanfoods
feeds.description: Look to this blog for nutrition and lifestyle trends, agricultural issues, and timely updates on FDA actions, trade regulations, and other matters affecting the market for German foods and beverages in North America.

feeds.title: Bianca Zapatka
feeds.description: Find Healthy vegan recipes, which are quick and easy to make. Foodblog with tasty foodporn, food photography and styling. Welcome to my blog! I'm Bianca - author, photographer, food stylist and recipe developer behind this food blog. My goal is to inspire people to eat healthier, adding more fresh and homemade foods in their nutrition, but also want to show that making anything from scratch is not as difficult as many people may think.

feeds.title: feines gemüse
feeds.description: Ein Foodblog aus Düsseldorf mit über 300 vegetarischen und veganen Rezepten immer lecker, größtenteils gesund, nie kompliziert. Mein Name ist Christina und ich habe ein großes Herz für Gemüse. Seit 2011 verewige ich auf meinem Blog vegetarische und vegane Alltagsrezepte aus frischen und saisonalen Zutaten, die sich auch schnell nach der Arbeit zubereiten lassen.

feeds.title: Kitchen Frau Food » German Cooking
feeds.description: This blog is about Canadian food with a German flair and a gluten-free twist. Find all my recipes with a German twist and some traditional German cuisine. I'm a first-generation Canadian born to German immigrant parents, learning to cook from my talented and innovative mother, and influenced by all the other good-cooking German aunts and omas in the family, too.

feeds.title: Spoonfuls of Germany
feeds.description: Spoonfuls of Germany is my book on German regional cuisine. First released in 2004, re-released nine years later as an expanded and updated edition. While working on the new edition I realized that there were still many more German recipes to discover and stories to tell so I started this blog.

feeds.title: The Oma Way
feeds.description: The Oma Way features authentic German recipes for homemade meals. You will find recipes as well as information and tips on how to manage German living in America. Oma is a German Grandmother living in the USA who loves to share her homemaking skills and experiences including the preparation of balanced, healthy food from German Recipes.

feeds.title: Seitan Is My Motor
feeds.description: Seitan Is My Motor is a bilingual vegan food blog dedicated sugar, fat, and German vegan cooking. A fearless diet is better than a clean diet.

feeds.title: Fraeuleinchen
feeds.description: Fraeuleinchen is a new young magazine where everything revolves around food, their preparation and, above all, their enjoyment. Besides the recipes we create ourselves, we also cook and pass on to you as well as beautiful photos of delicious dishes, there will be much more.

feeds.title: Pretzel and Me Blog
feeds.description: A German living with his German American family and his dog Pretzel in the US. Pretzel and Me Blog is a German food blog that celebrates the rich culinary traditions of Germany. The blog is run by a passionate foodie who has a deep love for German cuisine and culture.

feeds.title: Oma kocht
feeds.description: Omas beste Rezepte aus alter Zeit. Entdecke Hausmannskost für nostalgische Foodies. Im Foodblog findest du Rezepte, Küchenwissen, Inspiration und mehr.

feeds.title: My German Table
feeds.description: Welcome to My German Table. My name is Tim and on this blog, I share my favorite recipes as well as food of thought with you. My blog is all about German food, history, and culture. Here, I share weekly recipes of my favorite German dishes, mainly from Southern Germany.

feeds.title: International Desserts » German Recipes Blog
feeds.description: I'm all about helping you make easy german dishes using everyday ingredients so you can find more joy in the kitchen, thrill family and friends & level up your cooking & baking skills. I'm Cate, a former German instructor and intercultural educator turned home baker and cook based in North Carolina.

feeds.title: Ester kocht » German Food
feeds.description: Authentic German recipes from my German family-in-law. My family-in-law lives in the Bavarian region, Germany and they are very proud of their cuisine. Most of the German recipes on this blog such as German buttercream cake, Jelly filled doughnuts or roasted goose are made with the help of my foodie and best cook ever mum in law, Beate. My name is Ester and I am originally from Namibia. Here you will find recipes with step-by-step instructions and photos, which makes cooking easy.

feeds.title: Baking for Happiness » Recipes
feeds.description: Welcome to Baking for Happiness, the blog magazine all about baking and enjoyment. Our website is a meeting place for all those who love baking. It doesn't matter if you're more into sweet cookies and muffins or pizza and bread; if you're a beginner or a real expert if you like it opulent or healthy. I am Kathrin and with my Husband Jan, we both come from Bavaria, Germany, love the Alps, the Bavarian life, and cooking & baking. Together with our two children, we live in a small village near Munich.

feeds.title: Arthurs Tochter Kocht Blog
feeds.description: One of the most popular German-language food blogs with recipes that are sure to succeed, wine recommendations and culinary travel reports from all over the world. Astrid Paul, the author of this blog, is obsessed with food. Since the beginning of 2004 she has been writing down her thoughts on cooking, eating and life on the internet.

feeds.title: Lexa's Recipes
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog, I am so glad you are here! I am Lexa, a German national, living in Toronto with a passion for delicious and healthy food. I am happy to share my favorite recipes with you, hoping to inspire you for your day-to-day cooking or a stay-in date night.

feeds.title: My German Recipes
feeds.description: German cooking made easy! Traditional and modern recipes from Germany and other European countries.

feeds.title: The Kitchen Lioness
feeds.description: This blog catches precious moments in our lives that are otherwise so easily forgotten. Thanks for visiting my blog. I do hope that you will enjoy the pictures as well as the recipes.

feeds.title: All Tastes German
feeds.description: German Recipes, Cookbooks & Cooking Classes.

feeds.title: Delicious Berlin Food Blog
feeds.description: Delicious dishes from the oven, the stove and the refrigerator - with recipes, of course. And if you want to know what is in Berlin at exciting locations is recommended, here comes at its expense. Everything tested and found for good - delicious.

feeds.title: Fructopia
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Deniz a Strategist, Cookbook Author & Food Blogger based in beautiful Berlin! Tales from my fructose free, sugar free wheat free life in Istanbul Berlin!

feeds.title: Captain's Dinner Blog
feeds.description: As the captain's wife and enthusiastic cook, I write about travel and culinary delights with small insights into the everyday life of our seaman's family. recipes. Landing tips, restaurant and hotel recommendations. Come on board with us.

feeds.title: Testschmecker Blog
feeds.description: My name is Joachim Otto. I'm a journalist and photographer. And tasters. I like to cook and often. My food blog testschmecker is constantly evolving. It started as a journalistic food blog with a focus on enjoyment and affordable organic food. Then it grew into a blog with lots of recipes and how-tos. Because of the demand from my readers, the topic of enjoyment also included the topics of losing weight and healthy eating.

feeds.title: Chef Hansen
feeds.description: This blog accompanies me on my way to the stars, as a cooking diary, collection of recipes and inspiration when no cookbook seems to give anything. Chef Hansen - sounds very confident, but it's actually just a nickname I got from a good friend a long time ago. And somehow that goes with the topic of cooking and eating.

feeds.title: Golden Pear Food Blog » German Recipes
feeds.description: Welcome at my food & joy magazine. Here is your source for tasteful recipes from around the world, interesting and entertaining stories as well as culinary travel stories. And as I am born in Germany, you will also find many authentic German recipes here.

feeds.title: Berlin Food Stories
feeds.description: Dedicated to the very best restaurants in Berlin and to people who are truly serious about great food and extraordinary dining experiences.

feeds.title: A Sausage Has Two
feeds.description: Traditional, Seasonal and regional German food as explored by a British food writer in Riesling country: recipes, travel and restaurant tips, culinary traditions and more.

feeds.title: A German Girl in America Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from A German Girl in America. Each week we bring you our latest posts offering Gernaman cultural insights, Special giveaways, and more. A German Girl in America is a Culture blog by Karen Anne where she shares German Culture, Recipes, Literature, and humor with readers.

feeds.title: Meike Peters
feeds.description: Explore various recipes, places to eat in Germany and more! Meike Peters is a James Beard award winning cookbook and food writer, author of EAT IN MY KITCHEN, 365 and NOON (Fall 2023), and host of the Meet in My Kitchen podcast.

feeds.title: Backbube
feeds.description: I would like to share my passion for baking, for good, regional ingredients, simple & uncomplicated recipes and sometimes shamelessly sweet treats with you. Get inspired on my blog, browse through over 350 recipes and discover your passion for baking. I'm Markus from Ulm and I have a big sweet tooth! That's probably why my passion for baking manifested itself more than 10 years ago, which led to this blog, among other things, and regularly gives you delicious & simple recipes.

feeds.title: Berlin Foodblog
feeds.description: Albin is a swedish Chef and Julia a Fashion Designer. They live and cook together in Berlin.

feeds.title: The Wednesday Chef
feeds.description: Food and stories from a home kitchen in Berlin by Luisa Weiss a writer and home cook based in Berlin.

feeds.title: Just like Oma
feeds.description: Oma's German Recipes Blog brings you 'What's New' on our site. Stay up-to-date with new recipes and ideas to help you create those quick and easy traditional German foods and meals.
